state.description: Pending (enqueued, not yet released) → Released (admitted into active work) → Completed. At most one active assignment; cannot complete twice or before release. Cancelled (ADR-0040) is terminal and reached only from Pending: a RELOCATE unit of a slot plan that a newer approved plan for the same site superseded before it was released.

giftWrap.description: Whether the requester asked the warehouse to produce a gift package for this work unit (see ADR-0010). False when not requested.

sku.description: OPTIONAL inventory SKU this work unit's order line corresponds to. Omitted when not known — not every caller supplies one (see EnqueueWorkUnitRequest.sku).

lineNo.description: OPTIONAL order line number this work unit is for (ADR-0036). Omitted when not known — a unit created before this field existed, or one enqueued without `lineNo`.

releasedAt.description: When this work unit was released (Pending → Released). Omitted while still Pending.

completedAt.description: When this work unit was completed (Released → Completed). Omitted until completed.

cancelledAt.description: When this work unit was cancelled (Pending → Cancelled, ADR-0040). Omitted unless the state is Cancelled.

relocation.description: The slot-plan move a RELOCATE work unit executes (ADR-0040). Present only on RELOCATE units (pathId RELOCATE, reference = the plan id); absent on order and transfer work.

planId.description: The approved slot plan (slotting-optimization) this move belongs to.

moveSeq.description: 0-based position of the move in the plan's published moves.

blockedBy.description: The work unit (same plan) that vacates this move's toSlot; this unit is not releasable until that one completes. Omitted when it waits on nothing.
